metrics.definition: New users meeting the target customer profile per week
New accounts completing the first value event within 7 days divided by new accounts
Eligible trials converting to an active paid subscription
Active recurring subscription revenue recognized for the period
Beginning recurring revenue plus expansion minus contraction and churn divided by beginning recurring revenue
Failed recurring payments recovered within the recovery window
Completed customer workflows divided by started workflows, excluding test traffic
Material payment records requiring correction divided by material payment records
Median time from incident start to detection
Median time from incident detection to service recovery
Material production claims linked to Class A or Class B evidence divided by all material production claims

rules: Do not count internal ledger constants, document repetition, or generated narratives as revenue or balance metrics.
Every metric must record period, environment, owner, query or source reference, and data-quality status.
Test and live traffic must remain separated.
A missing source reference makes a metric provisional, not verified.
